About this map
Census tracts are shaded by the 2024 ACS 5-year median family income for families with own children under 18 (Table B19125). School dots show 2024–25 free/reduced-price meal (FRPM) share. Black boundaries show SFUSD 2024–25 elementary attendance areas. Hover over a school dot for its name, FRPM share, and attendance-area or citywide status.

Sources: U.S. Census Bureau; SFUSD/DataSF; California Department of Education. Charter schools are excluded from the school point layer.
